topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: I've always known this city plays by its own set of rules, but the latest twist in my living situation has only confirmed what I suspected: the game is rigged, and I'm playing with a full house. My apartment building, the place where I've carved out a semblance of normalcy, is transitioning to condos. The developers claim it's for the better, a step up, but I see it for what it is—a move to capitalize on prime real estate. Yet, here I am, not panicked, not scrambling. I’ve navigated tighter straits than this. This change, it's almost a challenge, and I'm not one to back down. After all, they're not the only ones who can play the game.
